note: window_minimize / window_restore are probe-side ShowWindowAsync(SW_SHOWMINNOACTIVE / SW_SHOWNOACTIVATE): never focus, never move (Rodney approved these two for this repro, 2026-10-17). minutes_moved = game minutes since the previous clock_state call

steps.note: clock moves
before: bit 2 clear, not iconic, clock moving
minimized: bit 2 set, iconic, minutes_total unchanged over 10 s (H5)
sends the restored WM_SIZE, no focus
restored: bit 2 clear, clock moving again

expect: PASS when every until holds: bit 2 set and clock frozen while minimized, clear and moving after restore. A FAIL at the minimized step with bit 2 clear refutes H5 (docs/85 §7)
